client.name: Stark Industrial KC dba Stark Industrial

policies.name: Commercial General and Pollution Liability, Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions)
policies.description: Comprehensive liability coverage for Water & Wastewater Treatment and Water Production & Handling Businesses.
policies.fullDescription: This policy provides specialized insurance for Water & Wastewater Treatment and Water Production & Handling Businesses, covering Commercial General Liability, Pollution Liability, and Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions). It includes risk management, claims advocacy, and loss control services.
keyFeatures: Covers Commercial General Liability, Pollution Liability, and Professional Liability.
Retroactive date for Professional Liability and Pollution Liability is 5/1/2024.
Specialized for Water & Wastewater Treatment and Water Production & Handling Businesses.

covered: A third-party is injured on the client's premises due to their operations, requiring medical attention.
Property damage occurs to a customer's property due to the client's completed operations.
A professional error by the client leads to financial loss for a customer.
Pollution incident caused by the client's operations.
notCovered: Losses due to acts of terrorism if not elected as an add-on.
Claims arising from events prior to the retroactive date of 5/1/2024 for Professional Liability and Pollution Liability.
Losses exceeding the aggregate limits for each coverage section.

policies.name: Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA) Coverage
policies.description: Optional coverage for losses arising out of certified acts of terrorism.
policies.fullDescription: This optional coverage provides protection for losses arising out of certified acts of terrorism as defined by the Act. It is partially reimbursed by the United States government and is subject to a $100 billion industry-wide cap.
keyFeatures: Covers losses from certified acts of terrorism.
Partially reimbursed by the U.S. government.
Subject to a $100 billion industry-wide cap.
Expires December 31, 2027, or policy expiry date, whichever is first.

covered: Property damage caused by a certified act of terrorism.
Business interruption losses resulting from a certified act of terrorism.
notCovered: Losses from acts of terrorism that are not certified by the Secretary of the Treasury.
Losses exceeding the $100 billion aggregate cap for all insurers.
Losses from nuclear events (if excluded by other policy terms).

considerations: Policy is subject to cancellation if payment is not received 30 days after effective date.
Minimum Earned Premium is 25%, and fees are 100% fully earned.
Proposal is based on carrier's terms and conditions, which may differ from previous policies.
Credit card payments for the optional Terrorism coverage may incur a 3% additional fee.
Terrorism coverage is partially reimbursed by the U.S. government and has a $100 billion cap.
